definitions.explanation: The legal right of a foreign national to reside in a country. In Japan, this is governed by immigration law and tied to specific visa categories.

examples.japanese: {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}を{取得|しゅとく}する。
{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}の{更新|こうしん}{手続|てつづ}きを{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: I completed the procedure to renew my residency right.

examples.japanese: {永住|えいじゅう}{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}を{持|も}つ{外国人|がいこくじん}は、{日本|にほん}で{自由|じゆう}に{働|はたら}くことができる。
examples.english: Foreign nationals with permanent residency rights can work freely in Japan.

notes:
Combines {在留|ざいりゅう} (residing, staying) and {権|けん} (right). Particularly relevant for foreign nationals living in Japan, as residency status is closely tied to visa categories and determines what activities a person can engage in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain residency rights
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}を{失|うしな}う: to lose residency rights
- {永住|えいじゅう}{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}: permanent residency right
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}の{更新|こうしん}: renewal of residency right

RELATED WORDS:
- {在留|ざいりゅう}カード: residence card (ID card for foreign residents in Japan)
- {在留|ざいりゅう}{資格|しかく}: residence status; visa status
- {永住権|えいじゅうけん}: permanent residency
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理局|かんりきょく}: immigration bureau
